notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for ordinary object registration and discovery fan-out. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies two registered objects, discovery of both objects by two active subscribers, owner loopback suppression, callback counts, object names, object-handle round trips, known-class lookups, and final discovery metadata. Attribute updates, object deletion, ownership, timestamped delivery, regions/DDM, custom transportation, MOM, save/restore, and provider-private behavior remain outside this contract.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador object-class lookup, publication, active subscription, ordinary object registration, object-instance name and class lookups, unsubscription, unpublication, resignation, destruction, and disconnect services with FederateAmbassador discovery callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador ordinary registration/discovery fan-out declarations
